name: diagnose
context_rationale: The orchestrating skill must hold pass-template content in memory, manage the sequential Agent-spawn loop, invoke write_pass.py after each subagent returns, and run assemble.py — all requiring the parent conversation's tool access and cwd context.
summary: Produces a single self-contained interactive HTML diagnosis of a target codebase for the repo owner. Runs 11 analysis passes (10 general-purpose subagents plus one cross-reference pass) via code-review-graph-backed code graph analysis, then spawns the diagnose-narrator named subagent for the executive summary, and assembles everything via assemble.py. The deliverable is diagnose-out/diagnosis.html, which embeds findings as JSON for owner annotation. Never modifies source files in the target repo.

agents.name: diagnose-narrator
agents.when: Step 6.5 — after all 11 forensic passes have written their YAMLs and summaries
agents.purpose: Writes the executive summary (sections/00-overview.md) from findings/*.yaml and summary/*.md using fresh context

external_tools.name: code-review-graph
external_tools.invocation: code-review-graph build|update | CRG MCP tools (impact-radius, review-context, search)
external_tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — builds/refreshes the code graph; reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
external_tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

local_scripts.name: assemble.py
local_scripts.purpose: Reads all per-pass section/finding/summary files, carries over prior-run annotations from existing diagnosis.html, marks NEW/PERSISTING/RESOLVED, renders the final self-contained diagnosis.html with embedded JSON state

local_scripts.name: write_pass.py
local_scripts.purpose: Orchestrator-side writer: parses fenced blocks from each subagent's response, validates findings, and writes the three per-pass output files (sections/, findings/, summary/)

local_scripts.name: passes/*.md
local_scripts.purpose: 11 pass templates (01-intent, 02-architecture, 03a-dead-code ... 03h-test-coverage, 04-ai-bloat) loaded by orchestrator and embedded in each subagent prompt

local_scripts.name: schema/finding.yaml
local_scripts.purpose: Canonical finding schema; read by orchestrator and embedded as a crib sheet in each pass template

name: heavy-architect
context_rationale: Requires reading the vault (triage.json, concept.json, risk-register.json, spikes, ADRs, actor files), interactive scope confirmation with the user, and writing multiple human-authored vault files.
summary: Heavy-mode-only skill that produces the comprehensive upfront architecture vault. Writes only the human-authored irreducible files (threat-model.json, cost-estimation.json, requirements.json, non-functional.json, diagrams.json, actors/) rather than derived component/contract/schema files (left to /sync). For brownfield it seeds the component inventory from code-review-graph code-graph analysis.

name: sync
context_rationale: Requires the full vault and project context (ADRs, triage.json, existing component/contract/schema files, slice history) to detect drift and regenerate code-derived views; drift resolution in Step 5 is interactive.
summary: Heavy-mode-only bidirectional vault-code reconciliation skill. Generates code-derived vault files (components/*.md, contracts/*.md, schemas/*.md) fresh from code AST/OpenAPI/type definitions, and detects drift in human-authored vault files. Also runs the cross-spec parity audit (CSP-1) via scripts.lib.cross_spec_parity_audit. Appends a sync record to sync-log.json.
